name: Cargo type classification code
description: Code specifying the classification of a type of cargo.

values.name: Documents
values.description: Documents Printed, typed or written matter including leaflets, pamphlets, certificates etc., which are not subject to import duties and taxes, restrictions and prohibitions.

values.name: Low value non-dutiable consignments
values.description: Low value non-dutiable consignments Imported consignments/items/goods in respect of which Customs duties and other taxes are waived as they are below a value determined by the Customs administration.

values.name: Low value dutiable consignments
values.description: Low value dutiable consignments Imported consignments/items/goods in respect of which Customs duties and other taxes are payable are below a certain amount as determined by the Customs administration.

values.name: High value consignments
values.description: High value consignments Imported consignments/items/goods which are determined as having a value above a certain amount fixed by the Customs administration, which may or may not attract duties and taxes.

values.name: Other non-containerized
values.description: Other non-containerized Non-containerized cargo which cannot be categorized by any of the other nature of cargo code.

values.name: Vehicles
values.description: Vehicles Vehicles which are not stowed in containers.

values.name: Roll-on roll-off
values.description: Roll-on roll-off Cargo transported or to be transported on roll-on roll- off vessels and which is transportable on its own wheels or stowed on special heavy duty trailers.

values.name: Palletized
values.description: Palletized Non-containerized cargo which is palletized.

values.name: Containerized
values.description: Containerized Cargo stowed or to be stowed in a container.

values.name: Breakbulk
values.description: Breakbulk Non-containerized cargo stowed in vessels' holds.

values.name: Hazardous cargo
values.description: Hazardous cargo Cargo with dangerous properties, according to appropriate dangerous goods regulations.

values.name: General cargo
values.description: General cargo Cargo of a general nature, not otherwise specified.

values.name: Liquid cargo
values.description: Liquid cargo Cargo in liquid form.

values.name: Temperature controlled cargo
values.description: Temperature controlled cargo Cargo transported under specified temperature conditions.

values.name: Environmental pollutant cargo
values.description: Environmental pollutant cargo Cargo is an environmental pollutant.

values.name: Not-hazardous cargo
values.description: Not-hazardous cargo Cargo which is not hazardous.

values.name: Diplomatic
values.description: Diplomatic Cargo transported under diplomatic conditions.

values.name: Military
values.description: Military Cargo for military purposes.

values.name: Obnoxious
values.description: Obnoxious Cargo that is objectionable to human senses.

values.name: Out of gauge
values.description: Out of gauge Cargo that has at least one non-standard dimension.

values.name: Household goods and personal effects
values.description: Household goods and personal effects Cargo consisting of household goods and personal effects.

values.name: Frozen cargo
values.description: Frozen cargo Cargo of frozen products.

values.name: Ballast only
values.description: Ballast only No cargo, means of transport is carrying only ballast.

values.name: Incompatible cargo
values.description: Incompatible cargo Incompatible cargo to be transported / stored with other types of cargo.
